notes: Seed URL over http returned HTTP 403; https www.medinacountytexas.org redirects to www.medinatx.gov. No Clarity site (elections.json 404). Results are PDFs on the pages 'Elections 2026' and 'Elections 2024-2025'. For all three target elections only Official reports remain listed (Official Results by Precinct, Official Cumulative / ED EV AB Official, reconciliation, PEHCA); any election-night unofficial reports have been replaced, so check 2 cannot tell what was posted on election night. The 2024 general 'Official Pct Results 11.5.24.pdf' is a Precinct Results Report with Run Date 11/18/2024 Run Time 10:11 AM, CreationDate Nov 18 2024, Last-Modified Sat, 03 May 2025 22:49:57 GMT. The runoff 'Precinct Results Report - Official.pdf' is a scan (Epson Scan 2) created Jun 23 2026, Last-Modified Tue, 23 Jun 2026 16:47:44 GMT. The May 2, 2026 local election (not a target) still lists only an 'Election Day, Early Voting & Absentee - Unofficial Results' county-total report, but that does not decide the target elections. HTML pages send no Last-Modified header. Check 3 pending: origin/wayback-data not present.
